description: Downloads one result file produced by a finished asynchronous job (e.g. the spreadsheet from getExportExcelTests). Images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP) come back as image content, UTF-8 text files as text, and any other file (PDF, Office, ZIP) as an embedded base64 resource; files over 20 MB are refused. Call it only after `getJob` reports the job as finished; the job resource lists the available file names. For the job's log instead of its output, use `getJobLogContent`.

jobId.description: The asynchronous job's ID, returned when the triggering call responds with a `jobs` resource. Poll getJob with this ID to check completion status.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

name: getJobResultFileContent
